selection: Reviewed concentration ranges; 250 nM LM411 remains excluded and available for a separately labeled sensitivity run.

affinities.interpretation: One immobilized binding unit binds one analyte molecule through an initial contact (x) and an intracomplex second contact (y). Both bound states contribute equal analyte mass, R = Rmax*(x+y); surface transport includes depletion and rebinding. Reports conditional KD_overall = KD_first_contact/(1+kclose/kopen). Separate initial kon and koff are not fitted. This limiting model does not by itself establish contact order or domain-specific affinities.
